content.title: J&J to acquire Halda, Sinclair takes 8.2% stake in E.W. Scripps
content.description:
Market Catalysts host Julie Hyman tracks several of the day's top trending stock tickers, including Johnson & Johnson's (JNJ) move to broaden its cancer research portfolio by acquiring Halda Therapeutics for $3 billion, Sinclair Broadcast Group (SBGI) taking a stake in broadcasting company E.W. Scripps (SSP), and bubble-wrap inventor Sealed Air (SEE) agreeing to go private in a deal with private equity firm CD&R.
